steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Moc Tru, a wood element boar with a melon striped body, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: snout sniffing the ground eagerly; (3) EAT: rooting face-first into the food; (4) EAT: gobbling messily, cheeks stuffed. Row 2: (5) EAT: lying on its side rubbing its belly, a happy burp; (6) PLAY: digging the ground with its front hooves; (7) PLAY: charging forward; (8) PLAY: belly flop slide. Row 3: (9) PLAY: rolling happily on its back; (10) PLAY: shaking itself off; (11) PLAY: oinking cheerfully, curly tail up; (12) REFUSE food: snout up, eyes shut, turning away. Row 4: (13) PETTED: flopping on its back, eyes closed; (14) WAVE hello: waving a hoof; (15) SAD: lying flat, ears flopped; (16) ANGRY: pawing the ground, tusks ready.
